limitations: OpaqueBody was appended to the public uint8 scope enum: existing numeric values and representation stay fixed and no virtual is added; downstream exhaustive switches must explicitly handle the new value conservatively. Rebuild consumers using the changed header.
The observer tracks original candidate scope, not unique identity, reference target type, ownership, full document output or native semantics. AC1018 adapter namespace remains gated.
